_dataset.name: coding-python
_dataset.title: Python coding
_dataset.description: Small Python tasks checked statically with regular expressions — generated code is never executed.

prompt: Write a Python function add(a, b) that returns the sum of a and b. Reply with code only.
Write a Python function is_even(n) that returns True when n is even. Reply with code only.
Write a Python function reverse_string(s) that returns s reversed. Reply with code only.
Write a recursive Python function factorial(n). Reply with code only.
Write a Python class Point whose __init__ stores x and y. Reply with code only.
Write a Python function max_of_list(xs) that returns the largest element without calling max(). Reply with code only.
Write a Python function count_lines(path) that returns the number of lines in a text file. Reply with code only.
Write a Python list comprehension that squares the numbers 1 to 10 and assigns it to squares. Reply with code only.
